APPROVE
`Read` and every extracted helper are well under 15. Behaviour is preserved: the comment and blank-line check, the branch order and the `i + 1` line numbers all match, and `IsDependencySection(_top)` should equal the inlined three-name check, though I couldn't read its body to confirm. The nested `Reader` only calls the enclosing class's static helpers and its `Importers`/`Packages` types match the `PnpmLock` constructor, so it should compile cleanly.
